description:
ANY FORKS OR PATCHES THAT OG AUTHORS WANT TAKEN DOWN WILL BE REMOVED TO STAY IN COMPLIANCE WITH MODERATOR RULES

Computica's Faction Forks
Restoring abandoned factions | Translating Chinese mods | Cleaning code | Polishing gameplay

What is this?

Computica's Faction Forks is a rehabilitation project for older Starsector faction mods, abandoned projects, and Chinese-language mods that deserve a second life.

The goal is not to erase the identity of the original mods, but to make them easier to play, easier to maintain, and easier to enjoy on modern Starsector installs.

This project focuses on:

Restoring older faction mods that are outdated, broken, abandoned, or difficult to run.
Translating Chinese mods into proper English, with natural phrasing instead of rough machine translation.
Code optimization and cleanup to reduce bloat, fix errors, and improve maintainability.
Balance and polish tweaks where needed, especially when something is clearly broken, awkward, or unfinished.
Compatibility bridging with major non-faction mods such as Ashes of The Domain, Industrial.Evolution, Nexerelin, and Star Lords.

Project Philosophy

These are forks, not hostile takeovers.

The intent is to honor the original work while making it playable, readable, and stable for the current community. Original authors, artists, translators, and contributors will be credited wherever possible.

If you are an original creator and have concerns about one of these forks, please contact me. I am willing to correct credits, adjust distribution, or remove material if needed.

Honor the past. Improve the present. Forge the future.

What I Usually Change

Depending on the condition of each mod, a fork may include:

Updated mod_info files
Crash fixes
CSV cleanup
Faction, market, and ship data corrections
Weapon, hullmod, and variant fixes
Translation and localization improvements
Balance tweaks
Removal of broken, unused, or redundant code
General quality-of-life improvements

I try to avoid unnecessary redesigns unless the mod is so broken or unfinished that deeper work is needed.

Chinese Mod Translation Work

Some of the mods handled here originate from the Chinese Starsector community. These often have interesting factions, ships, systems, and worldbuilding, but the English text can be difficult to understand or incomplete.

For those projects, I focus on:

Natural English faction descriptions
Readable ship, weapon, hullmod, and industry names
Clear tooltips and descriptions
Consistent naming conventions
Preserving the original tone where possible

This is not just a machine translation and upload.The goal is to make the text feel like it belongs in a polished English Starsector mod.

Development Tools / Assistance

I am also using Codex as part of the workflow.

Codex helps with code review, refactoring, bug hunting, JSON/CSV cleanup, scripting assistance, and identifying possible optimization paths. Final decisions, testing priorities, balance judgment, and release direction are still handled manually.

In short:

Human-led project
Codex-assisted cleanup and development
Community feedback welcome

Current Forks / Releases

This section will be updated as forks become available.

Kwin's Sector Industry Compilation: Updated 6/30/2026
Farsight Drive: Updated 7/16/2026
Junk Pirates/ASP/PACK: Updated 7/16/2026
Valkyrians: Updated 7/16/2026
FSF: Updated 7/16/2026
Blackrock Drive Yards: Updated 7/16/2026
Neutrino Corporation: Waiting for permission...
Mico's Gundams and Vortex Aliens: Testing...
Avali Expeditionary Fleet: Paused...
Eridani Combine: Testing...
The Nomads: Paused...

Patch Only Release

This section only includes Patches and/or Patchers

Iron Shell: 1.18.3aj 130+ Bug-fix log Only, Patch sub-mod removed Updated 7/5/2026
Stellar networks: Updated 7/5/2026

Each release will include notes explaining what was changed, what was fixed, what remains unfinished, and whether the fork should be considered stable, beta, or experimental.

Bug Reports

When reporting bugs, please include:

The name of the fork/mod
Your Starsector version
Your mod list
The crash log, if applicable
What you were doing when the issue occurred

Logs and reproduction steps help a lot.

Compatibility Bridging

In addition to restoring and polishing faction mods, Computica's Faction Forks also aims to improve compatibility with major non-faction mods and broader campaign-layer systems.

The goal is to help older or translated factions interact more cleanly with popular Starsector ecosystem mods instead of feeling isolated, broken, or outdated.

Current compatibility targets include:

LunaLib
Ashes of The Domain
Industrial.Evolution
Nexerelin
Star Lords

Compatibility work may include:

Faction integration fixes
Market and industry adjustments
Diplomacy and invasion behavior review
Campaign-layer balance checks
Economy and production compatibility passes
Correcting broken or outdated mod interactions
Adding support where the original mod never had it
New Buildings
S-Mod Support

These bridges will vary by fork. Some factions may only need light cleanup, while others may require deeper campaign-side work to function properly alongside larger modlists.

Notes:
Compatibility support does not mean every possible mod combination is guaranteed. The goal is practical stability, better integration, and cleaner behavior with commonly used Starsector mod setups.
These forks may touch code, data files, faction behavior, markets, variants, or translations. Compatibility will vary depending on the original mod and how much work was required.
I will try to document known conflicts when they are discovered.

Credits

Full credit goes to the original mod authors, artists, translators, and contributors whose work made these factions possible in the first place.

This project exists because old mods are worth preserving, and good ideas should not disappear just because a version number changed.

Computica's Faction Forks
Restore. Refine. Optimize. Translate. Polish.
